verdict.rationale: Bland's Evals use LLM judges to score call quality. You define eval agents that each grade one dimension of a call, and each judge decides whether the agent did what you wanted, which covers scoring and flagging failures. Evals can also be run through the MCP server alongside analytics queries. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that evals run automatically on every call without manual triggering, specific resolution/outcome analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
